q_intent.instructions: Which support category best describes this ticket?

criteria.PASSWORD_RESET: Login, credential, or account-access problems resolvable by a password reset flow (forgotten password, locked out, reset email missing, lost 2FA device).
criteria.ORDER_STATUS: Where-is-my-order, shipping, tracking, or delivery status questions about a placed order.
criteria.BILLING_DISPUTE: Wrong, duplicate, or unrecognized charges; refund amount disagreements; billing errors after plan changes.
criteria.BUG_REPORT: Product malfunction: errors, crashes, broken or misbehaving features.
criteria.CANCELLATION: Requests to cancel a subscription, account, or order, including conditional cancellation threats.
criteria.GENERAL_INQUIRY: How-do-I questions, feature questions, and anything not matching the other categories.

q_priority.instructions: How urgent is this ticket? LOW: routine questions and password resets. MEDIUM: functional or order issues for FREE/PRO tiers. HIGH: money at stake, cancellation threats, or ENTERPRISE functional issues. URGENT: service-blocking ENTERPRISE issues, security incidents, or explicit urgency with money at stake.

q_escalate.instructions: Should this ticket be escalated to a human agent queue? Escalate billing disputes, cancellations, security issues, urgent service-blocking problems, and enterprise-tier bug reports.

q_strategy.instructions: Which response strategy should handle this ticket?

criteria.TEMPLATE_REPLY: Routine ticket fully answerable by a predefined canned response (password resets, simple how-do-I questions, standard bug acknowledgements).
criteria.AUTO_RESOLVE: Order-status question answerable by looking up order data and filling a template.
criteria.CUSTOM_REPLY: Needs a generated, situation-specific reply: billing disputes, nuanced complaints, cancellations needing persuasion, ambiguous or multi-issue tickets.
